'''Jacklin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mining/Legends|miner]] who lived in Torbel, a village on the planet Lanteeb during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He and [[Devi (miner)|Devi]] convinced [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] to provide shelter for the villagers. He was later [[Death/Legends|killed]] during the [[Battle of Lanteeb|battle]] against [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] under the command of [[General/Legends|General]] [[Lok Durd/Legends|Lok Durd]].
